paper.title: SkillsVote: Lifecycle Governance of Agent Skills from Collection, Recommendation to Evolution
paper.central_claim: Lifecycle governance connects recommendation, subtask attribution and conservative evolution of persistent skill libraries, improving online streams and frozen-library offline transfer on Terminal-Bench 2.0 and SWE-Bench Pro.
